Set up a long-read sequencing pipeline to process raw nanopore data for variant calling.
families.discriminator: These skills focus on the technical handling, quality assurance, and preparation of genomic sequence data and reference materials, distinct from downstream clinical interpretation or specific model training tasks.

families.name: hic-analysis
families.definition: A suite of skills for processing, analyzing, and visualizing Hi-C genomic interaction data.
exemplar_tasks: Run a full Hi-C pipeline to detect TADs and visualize the contact matrix.
Perform differential analysis on two Hi-C datasets to identify significant changes in chromatin interactions.
families.discriminator: The skills differ by their specific function in the Hi-C workflow, ranging from data input/output and matrix operations to specialized analyses like loop calling, TAD detection, and differential comparison.

families.name: aistats-paper-lifecycle

Draft a response to the reviewers' comments and prepare the camera-ready version of my AISTATS paper.
families.discriminator: These skills are specifically tailored to the AISTATS conference guidelines and workflow, distinguishing them from general journal club activities, cover art generation, or ASPLOS-specific experimental tasks.

families.name: mathematical-modeling-and-verification
families.definition: A suite of skills for designing, coding, and auditing mathematical models and proofs using formal methods and computational tools.

Audit the consistency of a mathematical proof and explain the final method used.
families.discriminator: These skills differ by their specific role in the mathematical workflow, ranging from code generation and review to logical auditing and method explanation.

families.name: molecular-structure-prediction
families.definition: A family of skills focused on predicting and analyzing the 3D structures of biological macromolecules using computational models and databases.

Retrieve the predicted structure of a specific antibody from the AlphaFold database.
families.discriminator: These skills differ from other medical or drug discovery agents by specifically focusing on structural biology and conformational analysis rather than clinical planning, vector design, or general drug screening.

families.name: model-lifecycle-management
families.definition: A collection of skills for validating, optimizing, interpreting, and deploying machine learning models across various frameworks and domains.

Fine-tune a transformer model using Unsloth and visualize the training metrics with TensorBoard.
families.discriminator: These skills differ by their specific stage in the model lifecycle, ranging from data curation and parameter optimization to interpretability analysis, framework-specific conversion, and final deployment or evaluation.

families.name: molecular-computation
families.definition: A suite of tools for processing, analyzing, and simulating molecular structures and their physical properties.

Run a molecular dynamics simulation using OpenMM to analyze the stability of a protein-ligand complex.
families.discriminator: These skills differ by their specific focus on data I/O and standardization, descriptor calculation, or advanced simulation and generative modeling tasks.

families.name: protein-structure-and-design
families.definition: A suite of tools for predicting, retrieving, analyzing, and designing protein structures and sequences.

Retrieve the PDB structure of a known protein and use Foldseek to find similar structures in the database.
families.discriminator: These skills differ by their specific function in the protein lifecycle, ranging from structure prediction and retrieval to sequence design and interaction analysis.

families.name: proteomics-analysis
families.definition: A comprehensive suite of skills for processing, quantifying, and interpreting mass spectrometry-based proteomics data.

Import raw proteomics data and perform quality control checks before differential abundance analysis.
families.discriminator: The skills differ by their specific stage in the proteomics workflow, ranging from initial data import and spectral library creation to peptide identification, protein inference, quantification, and specialized analyses like PTM mapping or DIA processing.

families.name: rna-velocity-analysis

Calculate latent time and identify driver genes for RNA velocity in a stem cell population.
families.discriminator: This skill focuses specifically on single-cell RNA velocity and trajectory inference using scVelo, whereas other skills in the cluster address bulk RNA-seq quantification, alignment, or general differential expression.

Read a FASTQ file, reverse-complement the sequences, and write the results to a new file.
families.discriminator: These skills focus on the direct manipulation, transformation, and basic statistical analysis of sequence data objects, distinct from high-level similarity searching or general file compression utilities.

families.name: single-cell-omics-analysis

Identify cell-cell communication networks and infer developmental trajectories from single-cell RNA sequencing data.
families.discriminator: These skills collectively cover the entire lifecycle of single-cell data analysis, from raw data input and preprocessing to advanced downstream analyses like trajectory inference and communication modeling.

families.name: spatial-transcriptomics-analysis

Integrate spatial transcriptomics with proteomics data to analyze spatial communication between cell types.
families.discriminator: These skills differ by their specific analytical focus, ranging from data input and preprocessing to advanced tasks like deconvolution, multi-omics integration, and specialized agent-based workflows.

families.name: structural-variant-analysis

Call structural variants from short-read data using discordant pairs and split reads.

Prioritize and interpret candidate variants for a clinical case using population databases and pathogenicity predictors.
families.discriminator: These skills differ by their specific stage in the variant analysis pipeline, ranging from initial variant calling and normalization to downstream annotation, prioritization, and clinical interpretation.

families.name: ai-security

Identify and exploit broken authentication flaws or 401/403 bypass techniques in a web application.
